subject: Acme MAP: Recap & Mutual Action Plan (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme MAP: Recap & Mutual Action Plan (next steps)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're all aligned and to propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum. I've summarized the pain, goals, stakeholders, decision process, and suggested milestones below. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: Long inference latency on batch document processing (avg 1.2s/token) causing high cost and slow UX for internal analytics.
- Secondary pain: Lack of isolation for sensitive datasets; procurement requires clear data handling and KMS controls.
- Goals: Reduce per-token cost by ~30% for the analytics pipeline, hit 90th percentile latency under 300ms for single-item queries, and complete a gated POC with production-like data by mid-April.

Stakeholders & roles (as discussed)
- Sam Lee — Analytics lead (decision influencer)
- Jenna Ortiz — Procurement (contracts / procurement owner)
- IT Security — TBD (requires SOC2 + KMS integration sign-off)
- Engineering (integration + POC) — you indicated 2 engineers available: Alex and Priya

Decision process & timeline (proposed)
1) Technical deep-dive & POC plan (Mar 20–Apr 12) — define success criteria, provide access to a sample dataset, Redwood provides MAP doc and infra runbook.
2) POC execution (Apr 12–Apr 26) — Redwood runs POC with dedicated capacity; weekly checkpoints.
3) Procurement & contracting (Apr 15–May 10) — finalize SOW and any procurement paperwork.
4) Go/no-go and kickoff (May 13) — target production rollout Q3.

Milestones (mutual)
- Mar 20: Technical kickoff (Redwood + ACME engineers) — schedule 60m call.
- Mar 22: Redwood to deliver initial MAP (this email + attached PDF) and runbook.
- Apr 12: POC readiness sign-off (data access, test cases).
- Apr 26: POC results & performance report.

Open items / asks for Acme
- Confirm technical kickoff attendees (Alex / Priya / IT Security rep) and availability for Mar 20.
- Confirm procurement path and Jenna’s preferred timeline for SOW review.
- Send sample dataset or schema (+ privacy constraints) for POC evaluation.

What Redwood will deliver
- RDW-Acme-MAP-v1.pdf (attached) — proposed milestones, responsibilities, runbook, and acceptance criteria.
- Access to dedicated POC capacity and a short eval report with cost/latency breakdowns.
- SOC2 summary + KMS/HSM integration notes (we'll share the formal artifacts on request).

Next steps
- I’ll follow up tomorrow with a calendar invite for Mar 20 and attach the MAP PDF.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Appreciate the thorough recap. This aligns with our notes. A few quick clarifications:
1) Procurement: Jenna is the owner; timeline looks realistic — we need legal review but aiming for early May.
2) Security: I'll loop in our security lead, Raj (raj.khan@acme.com), for SOC2 / KMS questions. He'll likely want the SOC2 report and data handling checklist.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood can support a masked subset of production data for the POC (we prefer not to share full raw data initially)?

Thanks — Sam

Hi Sam — looping in a quick technical note.

We can absolutely run the POC on a masked subset of your production traffic. Typical approach: we accept a schema + 10k–50k rows of masked data (or a hashed id set plus feature payloads) and run the POC in a dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool. For SOC2/Security:
- We'll provide a SOC2 summary and our SOC2 Type II report upon execution of an NDA (we can send a redacted copy earlier if that helps).
- KMS integrations: we support AWS KMS + customer-managed keys; our runbook includes instructions for envelope encryption.

I attached the MAP PDF and a short technical runbook to this thread for reference. Let me know if Alex/Priya need pre-kickoff docs.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
